test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 10th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Find the LCM of (2)/(3), (4)/(7) {{and}} (9)/({13)}.
solution:
**Formula used:**

LCM of two or more fractions = (LCM of Numerator)/(HCF of Denominator)

**Calculation:**

LCM of (2)/(3), (4)/(7) and (9)/(13) = (LCM of 2, 4 and 9)/(HCF of 3, 7 and 13) = (36)/(1)

⇒ LCM = 36

**∴ The LCM of (2)/(3), (4)/(7) and (9)/(13) is 36.**
